description.$t:
Here are some notes for your league as we approach NFL Kickoff on Wednesday night!

  1. The NFL is kicking off a day earlier this season, so starting lineups for the first game (Seahawks and Patriots players) are due by kickoff on Wed night at 8:20pm ET
  2. There is a new optional lineup deadline available on the League > Setup > Starting Lineup Setup screen for Gametime with Wednesday Exception which will allow Wed night players to be submitted after their game is played. This is mainly for leagues that conduct their draft on Wed night and want to allow team owners to submit all players after their fantasy draft is done.
  3. If you run waivers in the preseason and you typically have a waiver event on Wednesday night, then you may consider adding a one-time Tuesday night waiver event. Please do not change your seasonal waivers or any other events if you want to do this. Just add one extra event on Tuesday.
  4. If your league uses the NFL Pools, then your picks for Seattle and New England are due by kickoff on Wednesday night.
